## Appearance

Stacy has fair, curly hair, which has been described as exceptionally lovely. She is also noted for having fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright and sympathetic woman who possesses a natural ability to win and keep the affections of her students. She is also very anxious to meet Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as a teacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she maintained perfect order without ever whipping her pupils. Upon starting her post, she quickly won the fondness of students like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and organized a project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. Later, Miss Stacy visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to propose forming an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, returning the following year to continue guiding them through their preparation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's dedicated schoolteacher and supportive mentor, quickly earning Anne's fondness when she arrives at the school. She organizes an advanced Queen's class to prepare [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and other students for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, offering steady encouragement and reassuring them of her continued guidance over their studies. Through her enthusiastic classroom projects and academic preparation, she helps foster Anne's intellectual growth and maturity.
